_comment: GREEN engaged fixture. package.json gives resolveVerifier a non-empty list; backstopCommands REPLACES it with a deterministic always-pass command that records each invocation to $BACKSTOP_SENTINEL (an env path OUTSIDE the repo, so running it does not mutate git status / the tree fingerprint). The harness uses the sentinel to prove the marker cost-gate skips a re-run on an unchanged tree.
